mechanism: Tobramycin may enhance the nephrotoxic effects of atenolol and reduce renal clearance, while atenolol may mask early signs of tobramycin-induced ototoxicity through beta-blockade effects on compensatory mechanisms.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, ensure appropriate dosing intervals based on creatinine clearance, and monitor for signs of ototoxicity; consider alternative antimicrobials if renal function is compromised.
